indicator.name: Estimated road traffic death rate
indicator.source_check: Confirm from the GHO metadata whether the published RS_198 series is age-standardised; the paper must state which version is used. The API response carries no age-standardisation field.

tables.name: who_rs198_2021
tables.series: WHO GHO RS_198: Estimated road traffic death rate (per 100 000 population) (all locations, 2021–2021)
tables.role: country-level estimated road traffic death rate, 2021, one row per location; the file also holds WHO region (AFR, AMR, SEAR, EUR, EMR, WPR) and global aggregate rows (spatial_type REGION or GLOBAL), which the data analyst filters out with spatial_type = 'COUNTRY' before any country-level statistic
tables.expected_coverage: about 180 WHO Member States with a published 2021 estimate; the count of COUNTRY rows is reported in data_summary.md as the actual number

columns.name: location
columns.description: ISO3 country code (or WHO region / global code for aggregate rows)

columns.name: spatial_type
columns.description: COUNTRY, REGION or GLOBAL; filter to COUNTRY

columns.name: parent_location
columns.description: WHO region name of the country (e.g. Eastern Mediterranean, Europe); the source for the country-to-region mapping

columns.name: value
columns.description: WHO point estimate of the road traffic death rate

columns.name: low
columns.missing: the GHO API returned no lower bound for the first rows checked (e.g. AFG, AGO, ALB); the share with a bound is reported, not assumed. Source check: confirm whether WHO publishes uncertainty bounds for RS_198 at all.

columns.name: high
columns.missing: same as low: the first rows checked carry no upper bound. Source check: confirm whether WHO publishes uncertainty bounds for RS_198 at all.

columns.name: updated
columns.description: time WHO last updated the record (the load's version)

source_checks: value: confirm the unit is deaths per 100,000 population and whether the series is age-standardised
low, high: confirm whether GHO publishes bounds for this indicator; if not, drop the bound columns from the analysis and say so
country_name: not returned by the GHO data endpoint; join it from country_names (see below) and report any location without a name

tables.name: country_names
tables.series: countries of the world, Natural Earth v5.1.2, 1:50 million, EPSG:4326
tables.role: country name lookup, joined to who_rs198_2021 on ISO3 (iso_a3_eh or adm0_a3) to supply country_name; the 110m scale omits some small states, so the 50m scale is preferred
tables.expected_coverage: about 240 polities; WHO Member States not matched are listed in data_summary.md

columns.name: iso_a3_eh
columns.description: ISO3 code with disputed-territory corrections; join key

source_checks: Some WHO Member States (small island states, and cases where the ISO3 code differs) may not join; the unmatched codes are reported, not filled by hand

tables.name: who_region_lookup
tables.role: WHO region code and name lookup for the six WHO regions, taken from the REGION rows of the same RS_198 load; the country-to-region mapping comes from parent_location of who_rs198_2021, and this table is checked against it
tables.expected_coverage: 6 WHO regions (AFR, AMR, SEAR, EUR, EMR, WPR)

columns.name: region_code
columns.description: WHO region code (location of REGION rows)

columns.name: region_name
columns.description: WHO region name as written in parent_location

columns.name: value
columns.description: WHO regional estimate of the road traffic death rate, 2021

source_checks: The GHO data endpoint does not return a region dictionary: the region names are read from the parent_location text of the country rows; confirm the six codes against the WHO regional office list before the paper names them
Confirm that the regional value is an estimate for the region and not an unweighted average of countries
